extracted.intended_audience: readers and subscribers of Nature (scientists, researchers, institutions) and prospective advertisers/sellers
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural information for subscribing to and advertising in (and selling scientific apparatus via) the journal Nature — includes subscription rates, advertising charges, submission addresses, and sales schedule for auctioning scientific instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address for advertisements and communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice: Advertisements and business letters for Nature should be addressed to the Publisher; Communications to the Editor. The telegraphic address of Nature is "Punis", LONDON.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send advertising and commercial correspondence to the Publisher; send editorial communications to the Editor. Use the journal's telegraphic address for urgent/telegraphic messages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription rates and terms
rubrics_metrics.description: SUBSCRIPTIONS TO 'NATURE' — Yearly / Half-yearly / Quarterly rates are listed for domestic and foreign subscribers (domestic: Yearly 1 8 0; Half-yearly 0 14 6; Quarterly 0 7 6. To ALL PRICES Abroad: Yearly 1 10 6; Half-yearly 0 16 0; Quarterly (listed)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscription payments are to be made as specified (rates given in pre-decimal currency). Subscriptions and payment details are handled through Macmillan & Co., Limited (see payable information elsewhere on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Charges for advertisements
rubrics_metrics.description: CHARGES FOR ADVERTISEMENTS — (OCR text) 'Three Lines in Column .0 2 6. Per line after .0 0 9. Quarter Page, or Half a Column 1 1 6 0' (rates and formats for placing adverts are specified).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advertisers should refer to the stated per-line and per-page/column rates when preparing submissions; payments are payable to Macmillan & Co., Limited. The page lists standard pricing units (lines, quarter-page, half-column) and the corresponding charges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment / Payable information and office address
rubrics_metrics.description: Payments for subscriptions and advertisements are payable to MACMILLAN & CO., Limited. Office: ST. MARTIN'S STREET, LONDON, W.C.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make remittances payable to Macmillan & Co., Limited and address postal/business correspondence to the St. Martin's Street office as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule and terms for sales of scientific instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: SALES are held EVERY FRIDAY at Mr. J. C. Stevens' Rooms, 38 King Street, Covent Garden, London, W.C., for the disposal of MICROSCOPES, SLIDES, and OBJECTIVES— Telescopes— Theodolites— Levels— Electrical and Scientific Instruments— Cameras, Lenses, and all kinds of Photographic Apparatus — Optical Lanterns with slides and all Accessories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Those wishing to consign or purchase scientific apparatus should note the regular Friday sale schedule and the types of items accepted; further details (viewing times, consignment terms) are provided by the auctioneer (contact Mr. J. C. Stevens).
